title: Long Story Short

request.description: Original collectible achievement artwork for a language-learning app. One complete square scene, native 128x128 pixel art. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, restrained 32-color palette, no antialiasing, no blur. Strong focal shape legible as a 64x64 thumbnail. Fill the square with the environment; keep the focal subject inside an 8-pixel safe margin. No frame, no lettering, numbers, logos or watermarks. Quiet romantic anime-inspired riverside landscape at violet dusk. A charming empty wooden bench with a clearly visible closed coral-colored notebook on its seat is the large focal subject in the foreground. A softly glowing amber lantern beside the bench casts warm light; its reflection and a few distant lantern reflections shimmer as deliberate pixel clusters across the indigo river. Lavender evening sky and a simple distant riverbank silhouette. The bench and notebook should read clearly even when small, with intimate storytelling and spacious calm; a warm place waiting for its reader. Painterly pixel clusters but firm pixel edges, luminous violet, rose, amber and indigo, no people, no text.

exportResampling: nearest-neighbor; originals retain their native pixels
